newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 5-yr note seen yielding 6.17/6.18 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 5-yr note seen yielding 6.17/6.18 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $12.5 billion in five-year notes on Thursday is expected to produce a yield between 6.17 and 6.18 percent, dealers said.
Sentiment going into the auction was seen positive, but the outcome was said to be "hard to predict."
At 1215 EST/1715 GMT, the five-year notes were quoted at 6.17 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
